BiblicalUsage: Mera' is wickedness, the mischief two kings plot together. Daniel 11:27 says both these kings' hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table, but it shall not prosper.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe lying at the same table is the picture of wickedness at its most polite, and it still does not prosper.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
